title: GROUND SHADOWS KEEP THEIR SPRITES ACROSS SCALES
why: The ground shadow store emptied itself whenever the sprite scale changed. The world and the bigger figures use different scales, so it emptied twice a frame and every shadow painted a new canvas every frame: slow frames, garbage collection and memory growth that crawled the full test run. The scale is now part of the key.
now: Ground shadows no longer repaint their sprites every frame; raids with many bodies and boxes run smoother.
